key.name: inactivity-minutes
key.description: Number of minutes of user inactivity before the privacy overlay is shown automatically. Set to 0 to disable auto-lock.

key.name: tint-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the colour wash drawn over the screen while locked, so it is visibly evident the lock is engaged. 0.0 is fully transparent (no visual indication beyond the PIN card); higher values dim the desktop more.

key.name: tint-color
key.description: Hex colour (#rrggbb) of the wash drawn over the screen while locked. A neutral light grey reads as a film laid over the desktop; a saturated colour reads as a colour cast.

key.name: lock-keybinding
key.summary: Keybinding to trigger the privacy lock
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that shows the privacy overlay immediately.
